full.$description: Pill / fully-rounded — a semantic constant, not computed 50%.

corner-k.$description: Corner shape curvature: corner-shape superellipse(K) over any radius. 1 = circle (off), 1.1 = DECLARED trade-off (NOT a geometric fit — the ζ=0.6 "fit" is retracted; see ADR-0002 §6 / config types.ts), ~2.3 = Apple icon squircle.

quaternary.$description: Top of the in-flow content stack.

grouped-primary.$description: Base plane of a grouped surface (card stack, list).

grouped-secondary.$description: Raised plane within a grouped surface.

grouped-tertiary.$description: Top plane within a grouped surface.

dropdown.$description: Menus, selects, comboboxes, popovers anchored to a trigger.

hover.$description: Доля тинта рецепта D, подмешиваемая в роль покоя на hover.

pressed.$description: Доля тинта рецепта D в нажатом состоянии — глубже hover.
